summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests).
